tasks.title: Contribution by Tencent: Prepared statement reprepare with optimizer trace crashes in decimal2string

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: debug构建下有完整DECIMAL参数、optimizer_trace及强制reprepare序列，可在四目标探索断言。后版验证不等于四目标已复现。

test_spec.setup: debug构建；开启optimizer_trace；建t1(dc2 DECIMAL(16,10))并插入1.1111111111。
test_spec.steps: 照cmain PREPARE SELECT dc2+?；以@a=1.12345678901234执行；ALTER TABLE COMMENT触发reprepare；再次EXECUTE。
test_spec.oracle: 服务器不得出现decimal2string/div_by_pow10的x>=0断言或崩溃；保留执行结果和错误日志，必要时多次新实例复现未初始化内存症状。
test_spec.target_applicability: DECIMAL、预处理参数和DDL触发重准备属于目标版本可测试功能，具体缓冲区实现及受影响性待执行确认。
